notes: Combat Type 2 test encounter: a separate experimental prototype. Nothing here is read by Combat Type 1.
All tuning numbers are VIDEOGAME ADAPTATIONS (designer spec, Oct 2026): 2 AP per turn, Move 4 tiles, Phaser range 6, 3 Hits = defeated.

Maps are separate files in the project's maps/ folder, named after the map (any map can be picked in setup; defaultMapId is a file name); tile properties come from src/data/adaptation/maps/tiles.json. The 'hazardControl' tile is the Interact target and 'hazard' tiles discharge.
roster: the enemies placed on the map's enemy spawns, in spawn order. Extra spawns stay empty; a map with fewer spawns fields fewer enemies.

Implementer defaults awaiting designer review: diagonal steps cost 1; distance counts diagonals as 1; cover only applies to ranged attacks and only when a cover object is next to the target on the attacker's side; Push direction is straight away from the pusher; voluntary movement never enters an active hazard; a discharge hits anyone already standing on the grating; the hazard lasts until the start of the player's next turn; enemies make at most one attack per turn.
focusCandidates are display-only (Book: a Focus grants an Advantage, Captain's Log p.268; no mechanical effect in this prototype yet).

phaser.name: Phaser
phaser.note: Book (STA 2e Quickstart p.25): ranged attack is Control + Security, Difficulty 2 before cover. Prototype: Difficulty 1 exposed, 2 in cover.

melee.name: Melee
melee.note: Book (Captain's Log p.204 example; Quickstart p.25): Daring + Security, Difficulty 1.

push.name: Push
push.note: Videogame adaptation: pushes an adjacent target 1 tile on success.

interact.name: Interact
interact.note: Videogame adaptation: overloads the EPS conduit so the grating discharges.
